content: The DTC-specific Flash Malfunction Indicator Lamp shall be set to Unavailable / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .

The DTC-specific Flash Malfunction Indicator Lamp shall be set to Unavailable / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .

The DTC-specific Flash Malfunction Indicator Lamp shall be set to Unavailable / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .
